objective: Make `status.tracked_releases` report the release-tracked set the inventory serves. It reported 0 on a host that tracks artcraft-launcher.

defect.symptom: The daemon's status reply carried `tracked_releases: 0` while `calix inventory` served `artcraft-launcher` and `~/.local/state/calix/releases.json` held one observation.
defect.cause: `daemon/server.zig` built the number from `self.registry.entries.items.len`, where `registry` is loaded from `<state>/release-registry.json` — the daemon's own memory of what it has already notified. Nothing outside the daemon writes that file, so its size is zero until the daemon has notified about something, and `status` reported it under the name of a different set.
defect.why_it_was_not_obvious: The name was right and the number was real; only the set was wrong. Nothing failed, no log line appeared, and the inventory — a separate code path — was correct all along, so the two answers disagreed without either being an error.

the_two_sets.<state>/releases.json: The release-tracked packages and what was last seen for each. Written by the frozen Python engine; read by `Zigalpm.release.tracked` for the inventory, and now by the daemon for `status`.
the_two_sets.<state>/release-registry.json: The daemon's own record of what it has already told the user. Only the daemon reads and writes it. It is not the tracked set and `status` no longer reports it.

test_first.test: Calix.Cli.Zig/src/daemon/server.zig — "status: tracked_releases counts the document the inventory reads"
test_first.run: cd Calix.Cli.Zig && zig build test --summary all → 381 pass, 1 fail (382 total)

fix.Calix.PackageManager/src/release/tracked: `append` and a new `count` share one `loadDocument`, so the list and the number cannot be parsed differently. Both treat an absent, unreadable or malformed document as nothing, and both skip an entry that is not an observation.
fix.Calix.Cli.Zig/src/daemon/server.zig: `status.tracked_releases` comes from `release_tracked.count(...)` on the state directory. The registry keeps its own role and its own file.
fix.scripts/verify: Floors raised to the real counts, as the file's own comment requires: 1390 package manager, 393 CLI.

proof.result: 393/393 CLI tests, 1390/1394 package-manager tests (4 skipped). The new status test asserts the count against a document with one observation.
A scratch state directory holding two tracked packages and an empty registry answered `tracked_releases: 2`. This is the same shape that answered 0 before.
r5005.g95d20622-1 installed by scripts/install-machine (snapper 2544/2545). The live daemon answers `tracked_releases: 1`, matching the one entry in the tracked document.

left_open: `~/.local/bin/calix` is the frozen dispatcher and shadows the packaged /usr/bin/calix; its `inventory` and fallback paths prefer `Projects/calix/Calix.Cli.Zig/zig-out/bin/calix`, a dev build whose hash differs from the installed binary. A product decision about where registry/probe/verify live, not a fix to slip into this run.
